messages:
Alyssa: Heads up — we got the marketplace go-live window from CloudRange: May 9-12. Need to align SI announcement + HW partner co-marketing.
Priya: Nice. Do we have MDF numbers finalized for the APAC bundle? CFO asked for a final by EOD Fri.
Marcos: I have a draft allocation: 60% go-to-market credits, 25% co-funded trials, 15% joint enablement. Will post spreadsheet link in a sec.
Eli: Can someone confirm which partner tier qualifies for the co-funded trials? I thought only Gold+?
Jules: Correct — Gold and Platinum. We can make an exception for two strategic SI partners if partner success signs off.
Alyssa: @Jules ok with exceptions. @Priya, @Marcos we should map MDF to scorecard KPIs (install, demo-to-deal, marketplace listings). Finance needs the scorecard metric per bucket.
Marcos: Uploaded the draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/sheets/marketplace-orbit-mdf-draft (commented cells for KPIs).
Priya: Looking. Quick ask — will the announcement be joint press + marketplace tile, or marketplace-first then press later?
Alyssa: Plan: soft-launch on marketplace May 9 (tile + SI co-sell banner), press embargoed until May 16 to sync with partner PR teams. That gives us one week of telemetry for quotes.
Eli: Who owns the joint demo content and recording? I can pair with Product, but need an owner to shepherd SI contributions.
Jules: I'll own demo artifacts. @Eli let's sync Mon morning 10am PT.
Priya: Finance wants the MDF request in this format: bucket, partner, tier, KPI target, commit, redemption terms. I'll annotate Marcos' sheet and return by Thu.
Marcos: Added a 'redemption terms' column and sample legal language.
Alyssa: Need to surface this in the QBR scorecard. Action: @Marcos add the MDF take-rate assumption and projected installs to the QBR col. @Priya confirm numbers by Thu COB.
DeployBot: [deploy] marketplace tile draft uploaded to staging: tile_id=mrkt-987, preview: https://staging.marketplace/redwood/mrkt-987
Eli: Preview looks good, noticed the SI logo bleed on mobile. Small CSS tweak needed.
Jules: Noted. I'll open an issue and tag design.
Priya: For the exceptions (Gold rule), I need one-pager justification from BizDev and SI lead. Can we get that by Wed?
Marcos: I'll pull pipeline metrics and include a short narrative.
Alyssa: Great. Last items: marketing needs a one-sheeter for the QBR pack and a consolidated partner contact list (with PR reps). @Jules can you own the contact list?
Jules: Yep I’ll compile and share by Tue.
Alyssa: Thanks. If anyone hits blockers ping me. :thumbsup:
Priya: I'll update finance deck after Marcos' numbers.
Eli: Sync Mon 10am PT — invite sent.
Marcos: Adding MDF totals to QBR mock now.
Alyssa: End state: marketplace tile live May 9, press May 16, MDF committed and scorecard in QBR.
Priya: Sounds good.
Jules: on it.
DeployBot: [reminder] QBR materials due: 2024-05-03 17:00 PT
